name: invalid-args
description: Recorded live 2026-11-03, same key as the fixtures above (limit validation runs before any balance check, so this succeeds even with 0 credits remaining -- called 6th, after insufficient-credits.json). limit: 30 is above the live-verified 1-25 range and is rejected outright as a body-level JSON-RPC error (HTTP 200, error.data.error_reason: 'invalid_args'), not clamped down to 25 -- same 'checked before payment, never charged' guarantee as every other tool here (error.data.checked_before_payment / no_payment_required: true). provider.ts's lifecycle.start maps this to httpStatus 400 over providerHttpStatus 200.

error.message: Parameter "limit" must be an integer from 1 to 25; received 30. Values above 25 are rejected rather than clamped. Narrow the filters instead.
